name: GCSE Business Prep: Bizmere
subtitle: Adaptive revision, labs, mocks
shortDescription: Adaptive GCSE Business revision: every spec point, break-even and cash-flow labs, real-world ventures and board-style mocks.
longDescription:
GCSE Business Prep: Bizmere is a personalised, adaptive revision app for GCSE Business in England. It follows the DfE subject content and maps every point to the AQA 8132, Pearson Edexcel 1BS0 and OCR J204 specifications.

### Learn
- 50 short lessons in syllabus order, each with worked examples, key terms and exam technique
- Switch to Real-World to learn by running small fictional businesses step by step
- Every lesson links to the specification: 140 points, nothing left out of the specification outline

### Practise
- 1,244 original questions across 140 specification points, at core, standard and stretch levels
- Adaptive quizzes pick your weakest and unseen topics and match difficulty to you
- Wrong answers link straight to a Fix-it lesson and a short practice set
- Unit tests and a cumulative check

### Explore
- Break-even, cash-flow and organisation labs are free
- Margins and ARR, market price, stock control, marketing mix, economies of scale and production method labs in Plus
- Real-world ventures: bakery, bike shop, cafe cash, team building (free); candle workshop, online shop, export, investment (Plus)

### Check
- Coverage screen shows every specification point, question counts and board mapping
- Curriculum map: where each unit continues in A Level, IB Business Management and AP Business with Personal Finance
- Board-style mock papers and write-it practice with self-marking checklists in Plus

BIZMERE PLUS (optional)
One monthly subscription (US$2.99). Cancel any time in your store account settings: cancelling takes effect from the next billing period, so you keep Plus until the end of the month you paid for. The free part of the app stays free: all lessons, quizzes with Fix-it links, unit tests, three labs and four ventures.

Text size from 50% to 300%, phones and tablets. Not affiliated with or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR, WJEC Eduqas, Ofqual or the Department for Education. Original practice material; check your own board's specification.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
